propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures during review-plan runs are invisible to callers; failed judge batches return abstain without reporting the failure count to the verdict JSON
The single runner seam at PydanticAIRunner.run:573 already records failures to a spend log but does not surface them in-memory to the verdict object

A run-scoped contextvars sink in a new leaf module records each non-fatal LLM step failure by call label and drains into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, keeping clean runs byte-identical for attestation safety
The failure counter is shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<call_label>: <int>}} and uses the runner's _call_label verbatim so operators can correlate with logged warnings
Text output via _render_plan_review_text prints one line naming total and per-step counts when the key is present, and nothing when absent, without affecting verdict string or exit code
